scope: Two new synthetic material installer/module test files
Maintained lifecycle RFC and sanitized source evidence

review.kind: Delegated release-engineering preparation and primary implementation/failure-boundary review

limitations: Tests use fixed synthetic inputs and temporary Linux filesystems with narrowly simulated ownership/mount/guest observations; no retained generation or actual lab was invoked.
Root, exact empty generation and both host locks must be provisioned separately. All partial output is retained; every nonempty retry refuses.
Guest/boot/context and observed local ext4/xfs ancestry establish consistency, not physical VM isolation, storage provenance or operator authority.
Advisory locks coordinate cooperating writers. The tree is not atomically published against arbitrary privileged writers; arbitrary filesystem syscalls are not wall-clock bounded.

Completion bytes are a non-self-referential marker, not acknowledgment or execution permission. Only a returned receipt reports completed fsync/readback; cold bytes cannot prove prior acknowledgment or power-loss recovery.
Seed files stay ordinary inputs. Attributable Docker creation, named-volume backing continuity, seed installation and independent interrupted-state reconciliation remain unfinished.

Fresh observations, capacity/bootstrap/admission must be re-established after staging. Full lifecycle harness, VM/console/operator scope, global release/lint, H7/W16, Coordinator and private-backup gates remain open.
